title: AI Router Adoption Triples CFO Accepted AI Outcome Reporting
description:
A fascinating early signal from State of Tokenomics data: "Practitioners using or implementing a router (i.e., those who've already started the router journey) are roughly three times as likely as those without a router to say that they can connect AI spend to a business outcome that their CFO would accept."

#tokenomics #aieconomics #tokeneconomics #airouter
